title: order-request
description: What intake makes of an issue: a request for one order, or a refusal with its reason.

title.description: A short title for the order, in plain words.

goal.description: What the order must achieve, in one or two sentences.

team.description: The team whose paths the work falls in, from config/teams.toml; null when intake cannot tell.

source_issue.description: The issue number this request came from; null when it came from the owner in chat.

refused.description: True when the issue is not taken on, for example because its author is not a collaborator.

refusal_reason.description: Why the issue is refused; null unless refused is true.

open_questions.description: Questions the specify stage must answer before the order can be written.
